fields.Name: ListConversationDetailFeedbackStats
fields.UserQuestion: What are the aggregate counts and average for conversation feedback ratings (matching the same filters as the row-level query)?
fields.Description: Aggregate companion for ListConversationDetailFeedback. Returns Total, AvgRating, PositiveCount (>=8), and NegativeCount (<=3) over the same filtered universe (StartDate, EndDate, MinRating, MaxRating, AgentID, SearchText). Used by the Agent Feedback admin page to populate the four stat cards.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Single aggregate SELECT against __mj.ConversationDetail WHERE UserRating IS NOT NULL with the same LEFT JOINs and Nunjucks filter blocks as ListConversationDetailFeedback. Returns four scalars in a single row.

fields.Name: StartDate
fields.Description: Start date filter for conversation details. Guarded by truthiness check — empty string will cause this clause to be omitted.

fields.Name: EndDate
fields.Description: End date filter for conversation details. Guarded by truthiness check — empty string will cause this clause to be omitted.

fields.Name: MinRating
fields.Description: Minimum user rating to include. Guarded by truthiness check — value 0 will cause this clause to be skipped.

fields.Name: MaxRating
fields.Description: Maximum user rating to include. Guarded by truthiness check — value 0 will cause this clause to be skipped.

fields.Name: AgentID
fields.Description: Filter to a specific AI agent by its unique identifier. Guarded by truthiness check — empty string will cause this clause to be omitted.

fields.Name: SearchText
fields.Description: Text used for free‑text search across feedback, message, agent name, user name and email. Guarded by truthiness check — empty string will cause this clause to be omitted.

fields.Name: Total
fields.Description: Total number of conversation detail rows that match the filter
fields.ComputationDescription: COUNT(*) aggregate counting all matching rows

fields.Name: AvgRating
fields.Description: Average user rating across matching rows
fields.ComputationDescription: AVG(CAST(cd.UserRating AS FLOAT)) computes the mean rating

fields.Name: PositiveCount
fields.Description: Count of rows with a user rating of 8 or higher
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM of CASE expression that adds 1 for each rating >= 8

fields.Name: NegativeCount
fields.Description: Count of rows with a user rating of 3 or lower
fields.ComputationDescription: SUM of CASE expression that adds 1 for each rating <= 3
